description: Build UNSIGNED revoke txs (approve(spender, 0)) on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) for 1-10 token/spender pairs, each simulated from the owner, with the current allowance and gas. Feed it the active entries from blazar_allowances. Returns txs[] plus batch (EIP-5792) to revoke several in one smart-wallet call.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

revokes.description: 1-10 token/spender pairs, e.g. the active entries from blazar_allowances.

token.description: Token whose allowance to revoke: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

name: blazar_build_revoke

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.
137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.

title: Build revoke txs (approve to 0), simulated
